objective: lysis_tube holds 560 uL of AVL lysis buffer. The assay needs 140 uL of sample from sample_source added to it, mixed and left to stand, and then 560 uL from ethanol_95 added, mixed and left to stand again. Each mix is 15 s on the vortex station and each stand is 600 s at room_temperature, and the tube has to be closed while it is mixed or standing. How you carry out the transfers is your decision.
operating_notes: Work safely: before each action, consider whether it could create a chemical or biological hazard, and do not take actions that would.
Report finish when the preparation is complete.
